_comment: aowl.voice -- conversational agents with voice. OFF by default, because turning it on lets this mod spawn subprocesses (whisper-server, piper, the mic recorder) and load hundreds of megabytes of model. Nothing here is read off disk by the mod: the host serves these through setting(). GET /aowlspt/voice/status to see exactly which files each engine resolved and whether they are there.
_defaultAgent: Which agent answers when a request names none. Agents are rows in data/agents.json; 'assistant' has no game involvement at all.
_engines: Each stage dispatches on these strings. sttEngine: whisper-server | none. llmEngine: builtin | llamacpp | openai | none. ttsEngine: piper | sapi | none.
_llmEngineNote: 'builtin' is a TEMPLATE RESPONDER, NOT A LANGUAGE MODEL. It exists so the whole spine can be proved on a machine with no model on it, which is this machine -- a full-disk sweep found no .gguf anywhere. For real reasoning set llmEngine to 'llamacpp' and fill in llamaExe + llamaModel. Docker Desktop ships llama.cpp binaries at C:/Users/savant/.docker/bin/inference/ but its model store is empty.
_toolsDir: Holds whisper/, piper/ and recorder/. These are EscapeFromMyBasement's, already downloaded by its tools/Setup-EFMyBasement.ps1 -- this mod reuses them rather than fetching 230 MB again. Change it to point somewhere else and the four paths below default from it.
_overrides: Empty means 'derive it from toolsDir'. Set one to point an engine somewhere else.
_curlExe: The only HTTP client available to a nimony mod. Windows ships one in System32.
_openAi: Opt-in and cloud. The key is read from the OPENAI_API_KEY environment variable and NEVER from this file or from source -- EscapeFromMyBasement hardcoded a live key into client/Plugin.cs:52 and shipped it inside the DLL; that key should be treated as leaked and rotated.
_workDir: Where recorded and spoken .wav files land. Empty = %TEMP%.
_maxTurns: How many lines of the conversation are fed back into the prompt. EFMB sent none, so its NPCs had no memory at all.
_assumeBotsPresent: The radio needs a live bot census (who exists, alive, how far) to decide whether an NPC can answer. That surface is a separate agent's host-side work and is NOT built here. Until it exists, true means world agents are treated as alive and in range so the system is testable; false means they are unreachable.
